---
pagetitle: "Tested LLM workflows, prompts and skills for science"
description: "Tested workflows, prompts and skills, and short guides, for doing research with large language models."
toc: false
# list pages have no formulas: do not load MathJax from a CDN
html-math-method: plain
page-layout: full
title-block-style: none
listing:
  - id: latest
    # the newest tested material and guides (drafts L0 are in the Library, behind "Show drafts")
    contents:
      - "workflows/*/index.qmd"
      - "prompts/*/index.qmd"
      - "skills/*/index.qmd"
      - "agent-configs/*/index.qmd"
      - "guides/*/index.qmd"
    exclude:
      qflag: "L0"
    template: _templates/workflows.ejs
    sort: ["date desc", "catalog desc"]
    max-items: 6
    fields: [catalog, title, description, qflag, author, phase, model, tested, date]
  - id: guides
    contents: "guides/*/index.qmd"
    template: _templates/guide-cards.ejs
    sort: ["catalog asc"]
    fields: [catalog, title, description]
---

::: {.home-intro}
Large language models are changing the way research is done, and fast. This is a place to share what works: material tested on real research, by scientists, with the model and the date of the test. If you use it, please cite it: that is how the people who shared it get credit for their work.
:::
